title: PACT conformance runner report (pactc/v1)
description: Output of pactc run --json: the check of the fixture manifest, then one result per selected manifest entry, in manifest order. The lockstep test schema_test.go of package hop.top/pact-go/runner keeps this schema and the runner in agreement.

summary.description: Counts of PASS, FAIL and SKIP over the manifest check and every fixture result. pactc exits 0 only when fail is 0.

manifest.description: Check of manifest.json against its field rules and against the fixture directory. A file that no entry covers is a manifest-incomplete problem.

details.description: One problem per item, "[rule] where: message". Omitted when there is none.

capabilities.description: Optional capabilities the implementation declared with --capability, sorted, each once; empty when none (spec/v1.0/fixtures/README.md, Optional capabilities). An entry that tests a capability not declared here is SKIP, never PASS.

profile.description: Conformance profile of the run, set with --profile (default full): an entry of kind conformance in spec/v1.0/profiles/registry.json. Only the entries that list it ran; absent conformance_profile means ["full"] (spec/v1.0/fixtures/README.md, Manifest entry fields).

transport.description: Transport profiles of the run, set with --transport (default https), each once in the order https, stdio-ipc. Only the entries whose transport shares one with them ran; absent transport means ["https"].

by_profile.description: Summary of the run by conformance profile, with one member: the run's profile, and the roles it claims. It counts the entries of a kind the runner handles that the --fixture selectors select. A run that selects none exits 3: an empty run is never green.

selected.description: Entries that list the profile and share a transport with the run; each has a result in fixtures.

skipped_not_applicable.description: Entries outside the profile or the transports of the run: never run and never PASS.

skipped_unsupported.description: Selected entries that are SKIP: no command for their verb, no check yet, or an optional capability not declared.

roles_claimed.description: Conformance roles the profile claims, in the order of the table of draft Section 22.1: its five roles minus the omitted_roles of the profile's ConformanceDeclaration (spec/v1.0/schemas/pact.schema.json, $defs). full claims all five; single-owner omits Reputation and Learning. Additive: emitted on every member, not required.

fixtures.description: One result per selected manifest entry of a kind the runner handles.

verb.description: Verb that ran the entry, named after its kind.

details.description: Differences found for a FAIL, or the reason for a SKIP. Omitted on PASS.

skipped.description: Sub-checks of a PASS or FAIL entry that were not run, one per item with its reason, such as the receipt query without --receipt-cmd. Omitted when none.

capabilities.description: Optional capabilities the entry tests, from its manifest entry. Omitted for a mandatory entry.
